content.what_it_is: MATLAB surface-elevation snapshot plotter for Case_DATA2D_2Waves output 00005. It constructs a fixed 2 m mesh, loads eta and the matching mask, sets masked eta to NaN, renders eta with ±0.75 m limits, overlays copper-colored points at all NaN locations, and saves a filename derived from file_no (L1-L35).
entities: case directory fdir defined at L4
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L5-L6
file selector file_no defined numerically at L7 and overwritten by a five-character string at L10
mesh grids xx and yy defined at L9
eta loaded at L11 and masked at L13
colorbar handle h defined at L16
flattened coordinates XX1D/YY1D and field onedim defined at L24-L26
dry-point coordinates XX_Dry/YY_Dry defined at L27-L28
copper table colors and selected color_sand defined at L29-L30

equations.ref: mask eta where matching mask is zero
select sand point color from copper table

calls: clear, clc, and close all at L1
saveas, gcf, and num2str at L34
unresolved: Cross-line type-reuse defect at L7, L10, and L34: file_no starts numeric but is overwritten by the character vector '00005'; num2str(file_no) then converts character codes rather than recovering numeric 5, producing an unintended output filename (or version-dependent formatting) instead of eta_fileno_00005/5.jpg.
Range/version risk at L29-L30: copper is called without an explicit row count and row 190 is indexed; a legacy 64-row default colormap makes this out of range.
eta and mask at L11-L13 are assumed to match the fixed 500x250 coordinate grid at L5-L9 without dimension checks.
Dry points at L27-L31 include all NaNs in eta, not only values introduced by mask==0.
MATLAB pcolor at L15 ordinarily omits the final eta row and column as colored faces.
The figures directory at L34 is not created or checked before saveas.
